title: Nafsat al-Maṣdūr II ('Tubercular Expectoration (II)')

date.basis: MK: not dated; 'context puts its composition sometime between ca. 832-35/1429-32'. The only dated witness is the Majlis 10196 copy of 838/1435, made after Ibn Turka's death (835/1432).

occasion: Written after Ibn Turka's arrest, imprisonment and exile following the Hurufi attempt on Shāhrukh's life in 830/1427, to ask Bāysunghur to mediate an audience with the sultan.
summary: An apology describing the tribulations of Ibn Turka and his family in exile, attacking false Sufis and dismissing the Hurufi movement of Fażl Allāh Astarābādī, and seeking an audience with Shāhrukh.
